content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD inlet_shoal simple case that plots the generated bathymetry. Loads ../bathy/dep_shoal_inlet.txt (L2), derives grid size from the array (L3) with dx=dy=2.0 (L4-L5) and coordinates x, y (L6-L7). Defines rectangle outlines for the sponge layer (x 0-180 m, full y extent; L9-L10) and the wavemaker (x 240-260 m, full y extent; L11-L12). Sets a 5x6 inch figure (L14-L16), draws pcolor of -dep with flat shading (L19), adds a colorbar labeled '-dep (m)' (L21-L22), overlays the sponge outline as green dashed with a 'Sponge' text label (L25-L26) and the wavemaker outline as white solid with a 'Wavemaker' text label (L27-L28), sets caxis([-10 3]) (L31) and axis labels (L32-L33), and prints inlet_shoal.jpg (L34).
entities: n and m from size(dep) L3
unresolved: y_sponge and y_wavemaker (L10, L12) use y(end) so both rectangles span the full y extent; the sponge x-range 0-180 and wavemaker x-range 240-260 are hard-coded and their consistency with the case input.txt is not verifiable from this file
